status: Capability required; detailed implementation mechanism proposed, not implemented.

rules.when: A method has the designated tracing attribute
rules.instruction: Automatically provide debugging statements for method inputs and outputs. Do not require handwritten tracing statements in each method.
rules.decision_owner: Application Architect within Solution Architect bounds

rules.instruction: Include public, internal, and private methods. Do not restrict tracing to service contracts or proxy entry points.
rules.decision_owner: Application Architect within Solution Architect bounds

rules.instruction: Capture the declared input values once, subject to the reviewed value-projection policy. Do not evaluate caller arguments again.
rules.decision_owner: Application Architect within Solution Architect bounds

rules.instruction: Capture the returned value and successful ref/out results where applicable. For void methods, record completion without inventing a result.
rules.decision_owner: Application Architect within Solution Architect bounds

rules.instruction: Observe logical completion, failure, or cancellation. Do not report a returned Task or ValueTask object as the completed output. Do not consume a ValueTask twice.
rules.decision_owner: Application Architect within Solution Architect bounds

rules.instruction: Record the agreed outcome and preserve the original failure, cancellation semantics, and stack information. Do not replace the outcome with a logging result.
rules.decision_owner: Application Architect within Solution Architect bounds

rules.instruction: Use explicit typed code. Do not use a reflection-based proxy, runtime reflection dispatch, or runtime-generated proxy to supply instrumentation.
rules.decision_owner: Application Architect within Solution Architect bounds

rules.instruction: Preserve accessibility, signatures, business behavior, argument evaluation, and return semantics. Diagnose unsupported attributed methods rather than silently omitting them.
rules.decision_owner: Application Architect within Solution Architect bounds

rules.instruction: Use the approved logging abstraction and DI-compatible instance wiring. Define static-method logging explicitly; do not introduce hidden service-location calls into business code.
rules.decision_owner: Application Architect within Solution Architect bounds

rules.instruction: Apply the reviewed enablement and value-projection policy before formatting. Do not implicitly enumerate lazy results, invoke arbitrary getters, or serialize whole object graphs.
rules.decision_owner: Application Architect within Solution Architect bounds
